decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of western white pine: slender needles in bundles of five, 5 to 10 cm long; long, narrow, curved cones 10 to 25 cm long. Pine needles rot slowly. Colours chosen by eye; cone numbers plausible, not measured.

look.note: Authored: the drawn look's mean hue at the brightness chosen by eye for this species' litter, the relief the drawing has, and a tile its pieces repeat on unseen. PlantGen's litter tests check the hue and relief against the drawing.
